summary: 2026-MOD-003 | 8600 Combs Road Franklin Township, Council District #25 I-3 Punjab Property Inc., by Patrick Rooney Modification of Commitmen
A property owner wants to rezone the 0.11-acre site at 2003 North College Avenue from low-rise apartment (D-8) to mixed-use (MU-2) zoning to build small mixed-use development.

A property owner wants to rezone the 1.9-acre site at 4150 North High School Road from community commercial (C-4) to high-intensity commercial (C-7) zoning to build used car sales and heavy vehicle repair.
A property owner wants to rezone the 0.14-acre site at 1624 East 46th Street from SU-1 to compact single-family/two-family (D-5) zoning to build for residential uses.
A property owner wants to rezone the 0.093-acre site at 337 East Morris Street from SU-1 to low-rise apartment (D-8) zoning to build residential uses.
A property owner wants to rezone the 2.27-acre site at 2015 Wagner Lane from D-6II to compact single-family/two-family (D-5) zoning.
A filing at 1807 Central Avenue proposes construction of a single-family dwelling and a detached garage.
A property owner wants to rezone the 2.13-acre site at 4402 Madison Avenue from single-family (D-3) to heavy commercial (C-5) zoning to build commercial contractor uses.
A property owner wants to rezone the 26.7-acre site at 11150 Southeastern Avenue from SU-1 to agricultural/estate residential (D-A) zoning to build residential and agricultural uses.
A property owner wants to rezone the 27.28-acre site at 7644 Big Bend Boulevard from planned residential (D-P) to park (PK-1) zoning to build for use as a community park.
